package: CityNexus V18 Native Hermes Journey Experience
scope: V17 semantic core extended with future-event authority, bounded fact verification, native Hermes Runs/SSE boundary, and desktop/mobile Copilot experience

verification.futureEventAuthority: Asserted future events use Journey, Booking, Commitment, or Activity facts; unresolved targets remain review-only and are not persisted as current events
verification.factVerification: VERIFY_FACT captures bounded official-source observations as non-authoritative evidence and never creates an Event by itself
verification.nativeHermesBoundary: Official Hermes 0.21.2 profile is outside the repository, the CityNexus MCP V2 surface is allowlisted to eleven tools, and Runs/SSE endpoints are server-side only
verification.runtimeTruth: The frontend displays DIRECT or HERMES_NATIVE_MCP from the server response; it does not infer Hermes activity
verification.frontend: Vite 7.3.6 production build; fresh desktop and mobile Copilot flows completed
verification.nativeAgentProof: Not configured in this process because no DeepSeek provider credential or loopback Hermes API server key is present
verification.freshExtractGate: PASS; 22 focused semantic, contract, and MCP tests from the fresh extraction

notes: The release is assembled from an allowlisted staging tree and contains no credential values or Hermes user-profile files.
The official Hermes executable and dedicated CityNexus profile remain outside the repository at the Windows user profile.
The existing OpenAI-compatible Hermes adapter remains labeled HERMES_COMPAT_ENDPOINT and is not presented as native Hermes MCP.
